metaTitle: Custom Multi Color Highlighters | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom multi color highlighters for your team. Perfect for color-coding and notes. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom multi color highlighters give your team or event attendees an easy way to color-code documents, schedules, or training materials. Unlike a single-color highlighter, a multi pack lets each user keep multiple shades on hand for organizing by priority, topic, or deadline. Options like the PromoSpinner™ Tri-Highlighter or 3-In-1 Pen/Highlighter/Stylus combine several tools in one barrel. Imprint your logo on each barrel for a practical giveaway that gets used daily in offices and classrooms.
heroAltText: Assorted custom multi color highlighters with company logos, including tri-highlighter and pen combos
